verdict.rationale: Apple documents Thunderbolt 5 (120Gb/s) connectivity and external display specs, plus unified memory bandwidth (273GB/s) relevant to I/O planning, giving developers some concrete numbers to plan a dock/build around. However, there is no documentation of PCIe generation/lane count, internal SSD/storage throughput specs, or number of Thunderbolt ports per chip config. missing for 10: PCIe generation/lane specs, storage throughput benchmarks, per-port Thunderbolt allocation details, independent hands-on verification of I/O claims.
